name: FIRSTENERGY CORP

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18, accession 0001031296-26-000046), Note 5 — Stock-Based Compensation Plans (p.117), table 'Components of Stock-based Compensation Plan Costs': stock-based compensation costs, net of amounts capitalized, were $39M for FY2025, $43M for FY2024 and $44M for FY2023 (total costs $85M / $86M / $83M in the same table). EDGAR companyfacts carries the same series under SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardCompensationCost1 (total) and the capitalized-amount tag, neither of which the engine reads; the engine's own SBC tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) have no annual values after FY2020.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc — SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 under the engine's tags. The expensed (net-of-capitalized) figure is the correct OE deduction: the capitalized portion is already inside capex, so subtracting the $83-86M total would double-count it. The engine applies a single override value to every missing period; $43M is the median of the three filed expensed figures ($44M / $43M / $39M) and is exactly the FY2024 figure — and FY2024 is the median year of the 3-yr normalized base, so the base is built from the filed figure with at most $5M of error in the non-median years, immaterial against OCF of $1.4-3.7B and a deeply negative OE base either way.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Utilities sector — OE/capex DCF fits utilities names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-18, accession 0001031296-26-000046), Note 5 — Stock-Based Compensation Plans (p.117), table 'Components of Stock-based Compensation Plan Costs': stock-based compensation costs, net of amounts capitalized, were $39M for FY2025, $43M for FY2024 and $44M for FY2023 (total costs $85M / $86M / $83M in the same table). EDGAR companyfacts carries the same series under SharebasedCompensationArrangementBySharebasedPaymentAwardCompensationCost1 (total) and the capitalized-amount tag, neither of which the engine reads; the engine's own SBC tags (ShareBasedCompensation / AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense) have no annual values after FY2020.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
note: No positive NORMALIZED (3-yr median) conservative owner's earnings — OE DCF not supportable on numbers alone. If the latest year alone is positive, that is a flag to investigate, not a pass.

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
